content.title: Performance Disrupted | Competence Proof, External Sabotage, Visible Consequence
content.summary: A quarry surveyor converts cable sabotage into a controlled tether swing. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Competence and spatial risk are established first. + One external actor performs the visible disruptive action. + The disturbance travels through the same support object. + The performer reacts to that propagated state, not a cutaway reset. + The terminal result preserves the damaged anchor and causal geography.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one adult aerial surveyor crossing a suspended cable above an original quarry with stable footing. The torch weakens one clearly marked cable segment while the surveyor remains on the established line. The surveyor swings safely onto a lower platform as the damaged cable hangs above and the saboteur retreats.
